stale: The document revision changed. Your draft is retained; compare the latest content before restarting.
conflict: The revision changed. Review current content before discarding or editing this request.
saveError: The request did not finish clearly. Review current content, then retry the identical request.
restoreHelp: Restoring creates a new revision. Existing revisions and any open editor draft remain unchanged.
markdownLoss: Markdown is a lossy export. It cannot preserve UUIDs, exact table layout, reference identity or every formatting detail. Save canonical JSON for a complete copy.
patchHelp: Node save changes only the selected node. Section save preserves its heading and changes the following members until the next equal or higher heading. Structural operations require a clean draft.
outsideNode: Other nodes also have unsaved changes. Save the full document or isolate this node change.
outsideSection: Changes exist outside this section. Save the full document or isolate the section change.
activityRestored: Document restored as a new revision for {name}
